notes.title: Get ready – we're releasing SEX Hospital 💦 this weekend!
notes.content:
[h3]Step into the shoes of Dave, a new intern at a hospital. Your work duties will clash with distractingly seductive girls and a mysterious sex virus that is spreading quicker and quicker. Meet and get to know hot doctors and nurses, try to juggle your duties and relationships while trying to solve the mystery behind the virus. Attentively crafted hospital environments, deep characters with their own motivations, well-animated adult scenes in a variety of settings - you definitely don't want to miss all of this!

[b]Add SEX Hospital to your wishlist now and be there for the 18+ action and medical drama on time - maybe you'll catch a little surprise 😉![/b]

We're eager to see you playing - get ready, shift is starting soon! 🩺[/h3]
